title: headcount-sync-weekly-prep-notes
content:
Goal: prep for weekly headcount sync with Eng leadership + 1:1 w/ Marco. Focus: prioritize open reqs, finalize interview panel for infra staff SWE, align on org changes and backfills.

Agenda (30m sync)
- Quick numbers (3m): current open reqs by priority (A/B/C), hiring pace (offers/week), pipeline velocity
  - A: infra-swe (2), serving-runtime (1), sre (1)
  - B: console (2), product-ops (1)
  - C: growth eng (2)
- Critical blockers (5m): budget approvals, interview capacity, comp band issues
- Interview loop status (7m): infra SWE slate, interviewers assigned, remaining slots, debrief cadence
- Org adjustments (8m): backfill plan for Lina (moving to PM), temporary coverage, cross-team support
- Decisions & owners (5m): commit to hiring velocity targets, any role pauses, action items

Notes / Talking points for Marco 1:1 (20m)
- Congrats on quick turnaround for infra offer — need to lock start date and relocation budget.
- Ask: Can you confirm 2 interviewers from platform infra next week? Prefer: Sam, Nia (both PM/Staff). If not, fallback: Dima.
- Risk: candidate wants remote-first but high-latency test required for infra role (we should be explicit about occasional on-site).
- Headcount ask: Marco requested +2 for infra Q2; need to justify with throughput metrics (tickets closed, infra incidents). Bring charts? Link: ENG-4523.

Interview loop debrief checklist (use after each loop)
- Summary: candidate name, role, score (1-5), highlights, concerns
- Panel notes consolidated (who raised what)
- Fit/comp decision recommendation + salary band check
- Next steps owner and timeline (e.g., offer by Thu EOD)
- Log debrief to Confluence + update ATS

Immediate action items (my TODOs)
- [ ] Update headcount spreadsheet with latest offers/pipeline (owner: me) — link to sheet in confluence (by EOD Wed)
- [ ] Ping Sam & Nia to confirm interviewer availability for Mon/Tue next week (owner: Marco)
- [ ] Confirm relocation budget cadence with finance (ticket: FIN-1197) — email Shawn
- [ ] Draft short blurb for Lina backfill req (role spec + 3 must-have skills) — iterate with Janelle
- [ ] Add interview debrief template to ATS so hiring managers use consistent format

Open questions / flags
- Do we have headcount capacity if dedicated infra hires push start to Q3? Should we reprioritize Q2 hires?
- Comp band: infra staff SWE midpoint is currently low vs market for this band. Need comp review before offer.
- Interview fatigue: teams report 2 interviews/day limit — do we need to expand interviewer pool or reduce loop length?

Quick metrics snapshot (notes to pull before sync)
- Offers extended last 30d: 6 (accepts:3, declines:2, pending:1)
- Avg time from first screen to offer: 28 days
- Interview-to-offer conversion: 9%
- Interviewer utilization: 14 interviews/week per interviewer average

Prep checklist (what I need to have ready)
- Updated headcount sheet + colored prioritization (A/B/C)
- Candidate slate + short notes for infra SWE (names + score 1-5)
- Finance confirmation on relocation + hiring budget remaining for Q2
- Draft Lina backfill JD (2 bullets for must-haves, 3 for nice-to-have)
- Link to ATS debrief template ready to share

Notes-to-self style / rough thoughts
- Keep tone direct in sync — leadership wants numbers first then issues.
- If asked about freezing roles: propose temporary pause on C-tier roles, keep A-tier hiring live.
- Consider adding one contract SWE to cover short-term capacity if start dates slip. Cost vs time tradeoff — run quick calc during sync if asked.

Follow-ups after sync (post-meeting)
- Add all decisions to headcount Confluence (owner: me)
- Update hiring pipeline slack channel with action items and owners
- Schedule separate deep-dive if unanimous pause requested (30m)

Random links / refs (notes)
- Previous Q1 hiring review: https://confluence.redwood/reports/q1-hiring-review
- ATS pipeline: https://ats.redwood/candidates?team=infra
- Budget ticket: FIN-1197

End.
